origin: Cohort a9 (gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh) discovered, as open discovery rather than as a named task, that an intact dispatch-manifest hash guarantees no frozen source-byte closure. The coordinator verified the finding and found it broader than reported: four of twelve frozen sources had drifted. a9 also found that the seeded executable validator is weaker than the schema it implements, which is a false-green vector in an active control.
source_pinning_note: This spec deliberately pins by commit SHA rather than by working-tree path hash, because that is the defect being closed.

units.hypothesis: The seeded executable validator is strictly weaker than the schema it implements, so a document can pass the gate that actually runs in clean runtimes while violating the documented contract.

acceptance.assertion: For each of the three divergences — undeclared fields where the schema sets additionalProperties false, provider_state outside its enum, and result_transaction.state outside its enum — a document is exhibited that passes the current executable and violates the schema, then the executable is strengthened to reject it. All 23 seeded tests still pass and none of their assertions is weakened. Divergence is checked systematically against the schema rather than only for the three known cases.
acceptance.artifact: strengthened validate_contracts.py plus divergence fixtures and tests
acceptance.falsified_if: the executable and the schema still disagree on any admissible document, or a seeded assertion was weakened to make a fix look successful

units.hypothesis: Pinning a source capsule by git commit SHA rather than by the hash of a mutable working-tree path makes post-dispatch drift impossible by construction rather than merely detectable.

acceptance.assertion: A capsule is expressed as a set of (path, blob SHA, commit SHA) triples resolvable read-only from git alone; resolving a capsule from a fresh clone with no working tree yields byte-identical content; and a legitimate change to a pinned source produces a new capsule version with explicit lineage to its predecessor instead of mutating the frozen one.
acceptance.artifact: workstreams/po03/capsule/ implementation plus tests including a fresh-clone resolution test
acceptance.falsified_if: a capsule can be resolved to different bytes at two times, or a source change can occur without issuing a new capsule version

units.hypothesis: A dispatch preflight that classifies every pinned source as CURRENT, DRIFTED or MISSING and refuses to dispatch on anything but CURRENT would have blocked the four real drifts before any subordinate read a stale source.

acceptance.assertion: The preflight adopts cohort a9's three-state classification, exits non-zero on DRIFTED or MISSING, and is proven against the four real drifts recorded in source-capsule-drift.json used as fixtures, plus a clean capsule that must pass. It is a standalone tool the controller invokes and must not modify control_plane.py, which another cohort owns.
acceptance.artifact: preflight guard plus fixtures and tests
acceptance.falsified_if: any of the four real drifts passes the preflight, or a clean capsule is wrongly rejected

units.hypothesis: The four observed drifts can be reconciled into a verifiable capsule lineage computed from git history alone, without trusting any narrative account of what changed.

acceptance.assertion: A tool reconstructs, for each drifted source, the frozen blob, the current blob and the ordered causal commits, computing all of it from git rather than from the recorded evidence file, and its output matches the independently written source-capsule-drift.json. Any disagreement is reported as a discrepancy rather than reconciled by editing either side.
acceptance.artifact: lineage reconciler plus its computed output and a test comparing it to the evidence file
acceptance.falsified_if: the reconciler needs the evidence file as input, or a disagreement is silently resolved
